rationale: Separate product-status roles from material, component, process, functional, and experimental axes.
Keep by-product and waste as sibling roles; secondary role does not replace material identity.
Waste status is not a subtype of by-product status and does not establish feed eligibility.
Discard terminology belongs beneath waste role; source material identity remains separate.
Market waste is a source-specific waste specialization, not a by-product subtype.
Processing waste remains under waste unless evidence supports by-product status.
Offal wording identifies secondary-output role; exact animal or crop material identity must remain separate.
Residues retained as feed are modeled as by-product roles while residue identity and process provenance remain separate.
Shorts is a milling-fraction identity; role assertion records only secondary-output status.
Crop-residue component identity remains independent from secondary-output role.
